query:
SELECT cc.nome, ls.equipamentoId, ls.setorId, SUM(ls.valor) as total
FROM lancamento_salario ls
JOIN conta_custo cc ON ls.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE ls.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY cc.nome, ls.equipamentoId, ls.setorId
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 15;
